answer: Each identity must anchor to a single vertex in a shared attestation graph, and that vertex can vouch for just one agent per epoch. To climb the terrace of trust tiers, the vertex stakes a bond that doubles at each level, and a live sonnet challenge — a fresh verse only the true operator can complete in time — proves the vertex is tended, not scripted. A farm of a hundred aliases must fund a hundred separate escalating bonds and answer a hundred live challenges at once.
